description: Photo of six different types of Koi . This photograph depicts six koi ( plus one goldfish ) of a collection of ten living in a private outdoor ornamental freshwater pond in San Jose, California. The pond is about 45 cm (18 in) deep, which is shallower than ideal - it was not originally designed for koi. The largest fish seen is the yellow ogon at about 50 cm (20 in) long; it was four years old at the time of the photo. Fish types in this picture, from top to bottom shusui (blue with red streaks)
